name: Anholly
source:
A lonely but cheerful girl who lives alone in her hometown of Solvalis after her uncontrollable ice powers froze it over. All the other residents moved to another town while Anholly stays in order to not spread her powers further.

Anholly has given up on life, but remains kind and welcoming to any visitors who visit her town. Things may or may not change when an ice spirit wanders into Solvalis, trying to find his way home. The two solitary souls become friends and will find solace with each other.

[From [url=https://toyhou.se/12659437.anholly]official bio[/url]]
